svg.title: Four Gates Before Signing an NCNDA
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-ncnda-signing-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Four Gates Before Signing an NCNDA; subtitle: An NDA stops talking, while non-circumvention stops the deal without you; caption: Kill fake ICC paper, confirm real non-circumvention coverage, execute before disclosure, and strike buried non-competes or commission liability.; assumptions note: Gate order follows practitioner operator gates. Term guidance of 2 to 5 years is an IXH TRADING Academy range, and Cangem Global calls 3 years a hard bet.; note: Sources are Cangem Global Corporation, IXH TRADING Academy, Trade Base Hub, Dr. Chad Michael Altieri, David C Barnett, and Rafael Ludwig.; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the paper avoid citing ICC 400, 500, or 600 rules and avoid the IMFPA label?; pass next: G2; fail action: Treat it as fake and refuse to sign. ICC 769E is the only genuine ICC NCNDA.; gate: G2; question: Is it a real non-circumvention instrument covering affiliates, survival period, and remedy?; pass next: G3; fail action: Send it back, because a plain NDA only stops talking.; gate: G3; question: Have authorized signatories executed it and completed KYC with government photo ID?; pass next: G4; fail action: Share zero protected names, prices, or shipping details until they have.; gate: G4; question: Is the term reasonable, with no buried non-compete, buyer commission liability, or advance-fee demand?; pass next: Sign and proceed to disclosure; fail action: Cross out the clause, or walk away from any advance-fee request.

text.title: Four Gates Before Signing an NCNDA
text.tspan: Four Gates Before Signing an NCNDA

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Does the paper avoid citing ICC 400, 500, or 600 rules and avoid the IMFPA label?; pass next: G2; fail action: Treat it as fake and refuse to sign. ICC 769E is the only genuine ICC NCNDA.
gate: G2; question: Is it a real non-circumvention instrument covering affiliates, survival period, and remedy?; pass next: G3; fail action: Send it back, because a plain NDA only stops talking.

gate: G3; question: Have authorized signatories executed it and completed KYC with government photo ID?; pass next: G4; fail action: Share zero protected names, prices, or shipping details until they have.

gate: G4; question: Is the term reasonable, with no buried non-compete, buyer commission liability, or advance-fee demand?; pass next: Sign and proceed to disclosure; fail action: Cross out the clause, or walk away from any advance-fee request.

text.title: Assumptions: Gate order follows practitioner operator gates. Term guidance of 2 to 5 years is an IXH TRADING Academy range, and Cangem Global calls 3 years a hard bet.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Gate order follows practitioner operator gates. Term guidance of 2 to 5 years is an IXH TRADING Academy range, and
Cangem Global calls 3 years a hard bet.
